- model routing/fallbacks across regions

We're trying to find one or two windows that get reasonable overlap between US / EU / APAC teams. We have the following rough availability windows on our side:
- Mei (SGT): afternoons 13:00–18:00 SGT (UTC+8)
- Samir (GMT): mornings 08:00–12:00 GMT
- Alex (EST): mornings 08:00–11:00 ET

Can Redwood's solutions engineer join? Ideally we'd have a 90-minute slot that includes some hands-on time and a quick run-through of the sample workload. Also — quick note: our legal/compliance folks asked for an agenda and any SOW draft you can share ahead of time.

Thanks,

Hi Alex — great to hear. Dev (SE) and Rishi (AE) are looped in.

Quick notes up front: US daylight saving starts 8 March 2026 which shifts US times by +1 hour relative to GMT until EU DST starts later in March. We can either:
1) lock sessions before 8 Mar to avoid a DST shift mid-cycle, or
2) schedule after and call out the offset explicitly.

Given everyone's windows, my recommendation is to run two 75–90 minute sessions:
- Session A (US + EU focus): technical deep dive for NYC/London engineers, hands-on testing for us to validate routing and caching.
- Session B (EU + APAC focus): overlap later for Singapore/London with recording for US if they need it.

Proposed candidate times (all shown with multiple TZs for clarity):
- Option 1 (US/EU friendly) — Tue 3 Mar 2026, 11:00 ET / 16:00 GMT / 00:00 SGT (next day)
- Option 2 (EU/APAC friendly) — Wed 4 Mar 2026, 08:30 GMT / 16:30 SGT / 03:30 ET

Dev, can you share SE availability and whether 16:30 SGT is workable for a hands-on session? I'll attach a draft agenda and a SOW snippet for legal to review.

Thanks,
Marissa

- Regarding DST: US shifts +1 on 8 Mar; if we schedule after that date, the ET <> GMT delta changes, so call out the zone per invite.

Updated candidate times (I used UTC for unambiguous scheduling):
- Session A (US/EU): 2026-03-03 16:00 UTC (11:00 ET / 16:00 GMT / 00:00 SGT) — OK if EMEA can do the late afternoon; gives US morning.
- Session B (EU/APAC): 2026-03-04 09:00 UTC (09:00 GMT / 17:00 SGT / 04:00 ET) — moves EMEA to morning and APAC to late afternoon.

If we do two sessions, I can prepare a short test plan and a minimal dataset for the hands-on portion. Marking items we need: test keys, target model, expected throughput.
